# Alali Homes

> Alali Homes Ltd is a property management company offering fully managed lettings to landlords in London and the South East. We keep landlords' properties occupied with vetted working professionals on fixed-term stays, handle every changeover, and report every month's income through a landlord portal.

## Key facts

- Company: Alali Homes Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 17095100, registered office 86-90 Paul Street, London EC2A 4NE.
- Contact: info@alalihomes.com, 020 4515 8438, or the enquiry form at https://www.alalihomes.com/#contact
- Areas: all 32 London boroughs, plus Kent, Surrey, East Sussex, West Sussex, Hampshire, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire and Oxfordshire. Every property is assessed individually.
- Who stays: working professionals only, such as people relocating for work, on contract placements, or placed by their employer. Every occupant is vetted. Not holiday lets.
- Fee: 15% of the rent occupants pay. The landlord receives the other 85% every month with a written statement. The fee covers keeping the property occupied, vetting, check-ins and check-outs, cleans and inspections between occupants, maintenance coordination, compliance tracking and the landlord portal.
- Income floor: if a landlord's payouts across a quarter fall below 60% of the property's long-term market rent, Alali Homes reduces or waives its fee for that quarter to make up the difference, up to the full value of the fee. The market rent figure and conditions are agreed in writing; the floor applies from the second quarter.
- Not guaranteed rent or rent-to-rent: Alali Homes manages the property on the landlord's behalf, so the income belongs to the landlord.
- Estimates: landlords receive a written income estimate for their property, given as a range based on local evidence, not a guarantee.
- Agents: letting and estate agents can refer landlords and earn a referral fee, agreed in writing.
